title: Portal Tech+
description: This mod adds portal stuff into minecraft with the help of Portalmod
body:
Huge thanks To VanDerVenom For making the models i used
Thank him for the models.


This Mod aims to add more portal features to minecraft with decoration's and functions.
The mod is a addon for Portalmod.

-----In mod-----

(The description will not update with each version)
The mod currently Has Glados main core, Portal 1 Glados Main core and Wheatly Main core
The mod also has decorations like Vintage blackplate Variant Blue
more will probably add more decorations and functions

-----Planned for Mod-----

I want to add more variants of things like old aperture cube droppers and doors buttons etc not fizzlers tho. And portal 1 ofcorese with the same set of pack.
